title: BC Friday Tips #28 Math Codeunit
summary: Business Central includes a built-in Math codeunit that provides constants and static methods for mathematical functions like trigonometry, logarithms, and common operations. Developers can use it to avoid duplicating mathematical logic in their code.
key_points: The Math codeunit is a built-in feature available to all Business Central developers
It includes constants like Pi and methods for trigonometric functions (Cos, Sin, Tan)
It provides utility functions including Log, Max, Min, Floor, Ceiling, Pow, and Sqrt
Using the built-in codeunit eliminates the need to create custom math implementations

quotes.text: Math codeunit provides constants and static methods for trigonometric, logarithmic, and other common mathematical functions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the core capability and purpose of the built-in Math codeunit that developers should know about.
